title: HYBRID RACE PLAN
subtitle: 12-week HYROX and The Hybrid Games preparation
level: Build, Standard and Performance - entry gate applies
purpose: Prepare athletes to run repeatably, move official race loads legally, protect station output and execute HYROX or The Hybrid Games without the programme becoming random fatigue.
tagline: Build the engine. Own the stations. Race the plan.
supporting_statement: BUILD THE ENGINE. OWN THE STATIONS. RACE WITHOUT FALLING APART.

track_descriptions.BUILD: Use the lowest rep/time prescription, run-walk when stated and L1-L3. Complete the entry gate before Week 1.
track_descriptions.STANDARD: Use the middle prescription. Progress only when pace, standards and recovery remain repeatable.
track_descriptions.PERFORMANCE: Use the upper prescription only after at least six months of consistent five-day training and stable recovery.

independent_disclaimer: HYBRID RACE PLAN is produced independently by SEVEN3SEVEN. It is not produced, approved or endorsed by HYROX or The Hybrid Games. The current organiser rulebook and athlete briefing always override this programme.

HYROX.doubles_rule_summary: Both athletes run together and share stations under the current team rulebook. Mixed Doubles use Open Men loads. Verify the live rulebook.

The Hybrid Games.doubles_rule_summary: Only one athlete works at a time. The live format doubles DB snatches to 100; other listed station volumes remain the same. Verify the event document.

entry_gate: Can train at least four days per week and tolerate a fifth easy exposure.
Can run-walk continuously for 30 minutes without pain that changes movement.
Can squat, hinge, lunge, carry and perform the event movements safely at a scaled load.
Has a race at least 12 weeks away or accepts that a shorter build cannot recreate twelve weeks of adaptation.

load_levels.L4: Race load: 90-100% with legal repeatable movement.
load_levels.L5: Controlled overload: 105-110% only for short sled/carry exposure and never to failure.

race_volume_levels.RV4: 75-85% of the official station volume; major rehearsal only.
race_volume_levels.RV5: 100% official volume; race day only unless directly coached.

principles: Standard first, then volume, then load, then density. Increase one variable at a time.
The last repeat should still look coached.
A hard Friday is followed by a lower-cost Saturday; the major Saturday follows a Friday primer.
Race pace is the fastest pace that survives the station sequence, not fresh running pace.
No-reps are wasted output, not fitness.

rpe_guide.6: Easy. Could complete many more reps or minutes at this effort.
rpe_guide.7: Steady. Sustainable for a long block.
rpe_guide.7.5: Controlled hard. Threshold work sits here.
rpe_guide.8: Hard. Race-distance repeats at target pace.
rpe_guide.9: Very hard. Reserved for peak sessions and race.
rpe_guide.10: Maximal. Used only on race day.

calculator.sled_note: Sled mass alone does not determine difficulty. Turf, footwear and sled design change friction. Use event load as the reference, but use RPE and movement speed to make the final training decision.

plan: Opening pace, target average pace, maximum acceptable drop-off, finish strategy.
Damper/footplate/strap setup, target split or cal rate, exit routine.
Footwear, body angle, lane turns, rope organisation, slow-surface contingency.
Opening set, planned set sizes, breathing pattern, no-rep response.
Grip strategy, turn method, break plan, posture cue.
Cadence, jump length, point where shorter legal jumps become more efficient.
Athlete A/B strengths, split plan, handover cue, struggling-athlete contingency.
Pre-race meal, fluids, carbohydrate timing practised in rehearsal.
race_tools.principle: Race principle: early restraint creates late performance. The fastest opening pace is rarely the fastest finishing strategy.

weeks.title: Establish honest baselines
weeks.checkpoint: Learn the standards, collect repeatable data and leave the first week with room to progress.

sessions.title: Strength + sled baseline
sessions.purpose: Establish usable force markers without creating soreness that ruins Tuesday.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Strength warm-up. Complete 2-4 progressive sets before the first loaded lift.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Trap-bar or conventional deadlift: 3 x 5 at RPE 7. Rest 2-3 min. No maxing.

blocks.name: Support + muscle
blocks.instruction: DB bench press 3 x 8; chest-supported row 3 x 10. Stop each set with 2-3 good reps available.

blocks.name: Race force
blocks.instruction: Sled push 6 x 12.5 m and pull 6 x 12.5 m at L1-L2 / RPE 6-7. Then 2 x 15 calf raises.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Deadlift load/RPE, sled load, turf, lane splits and any stalls.

sessions.coach_note: The baseline is only useful when every rep can be repeated.

sessions.title: Run repeatability baseline
sessions.purpose: Find sustainable speed and pace drop-off without an all-out time trial.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Run warm-up: 10-12 min easy, drills and 3-4 relaxed strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: BUILD / STANDARD / PERFORMANCE: 4 / 5 / 6 x 3 min at RPE 7.5. Take 2 min easy jog or walk.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: If available, make the final rep a measured 1 km without increasing effort.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: If available, record the 600 m split inside the final two reps.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Every rep pace, fastest-to-slowest drop-off, RPE and running surface.

sessions.coach_note: The final rep should look like the first. If it does not, the start was too fast.

sessions.title: Easy aerobic + strides
sessions.purpose: Build low-cost running volume and relaxed leg speed.

blocks.name: Main aerobic
blocks.instruction: BUILD / STANDARD / PERFORMANCE: 30 / 40 / 50 min conversational running at RPE 4-5.

blocks.name: BUILD option
blocks.instruction: Use 3 min run / 1 min walk for the full duration if continuous running is not comfortable.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the main prescription. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Durability
blocks.instruction: 4 x 15 sec relaxed strides with 60-75 sec walk; then 2 x 12 bent-knee calf raises.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Duration, distance, average HR if available and how easy the talk test felt.

sessions.coach_note: Easy work only builds the week when it stays easy.

sessions.title: Station standards EMOM
sessions.purpose: Assess legal movement and repeatable station output at low fatigue.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Station warm-up. Rehearse every movement with light load before the clock starts.

blocks.name: Format
blocks.instruction: 24-min EMOM, 4 rounds: minute 1 machine; 2 wall balls; 3 carry; 4 lunge; 5 BBJ; 6 rest. Leave 15-25 sec each minute.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: Use 10-14 cal Ski/row, 10-14 wall balls, 30-40 m carry, 12-16 m lunge and 8-12 m BBJ at L1-L2.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: Use 8-12 cal bike/row, 10-14 wall balls, 6-10 DB snatches, 12-16 m lunge and 8-12 m BBJ at L1-L2.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Completed minutes, lowest rest, load, no-reps and limiting movement.

sessions.coach_note: Reduce reps before movement standards disappear.

sessions.title: Controlled baseline brick
sessions.purpose: Introduce compromised running and learn what changes pace.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: 10-15 min easy run and machine work, then one light set of the first two stations.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: 4 rounds: 800 m run, then H1 500 m Ski, H2 25 m push, H5 500 m row and H8 25 wall balls. One station per round, L1-L2.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: 5 rounds: 400 m run, then G1 12 cal bike, G2 25 wall balls, G3 250 m row, G5 12 DB snatches and G10 15 m push.

blocks.name: Execution
blocks.instruction: Hold RPE 7. Walk 60-90 sec between rounds if needed. This is not a race rehearsal.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Run splits, station splits, transition time and first sign of breakdown.

sessions.coach_note: A calm baseline beats an impressive collapse.

sessions.title: Recovery + rulebook familiarisation
sessions.purpose: Recover while beginning the education work that prevents race-day penalties.

blocks.name: Easy work
blocks.instruction: 20-30 min easy walk, bike or machine at RPE 2-4.

blocks.name: Skill
blocks.instruction: Read the current organiser rules for your first two stations. Rehearse setup with no fatigue.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Recovery feel and two movement-standard notes.

sessions.coach_note: Skip the movement if it delays recovery.

weeks.title: Add useful volume
weeks.checkpoint: Increase aerobic and muscular work while preserving clean reps and stable running pace.

sessions.title: Squat strength + carry muscle
sessions.purpose: Build lower-body force, upper-body muscle and grip without metabolic chaos.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Strength warm-up. Complete 2-4 progressive sets before the first loaded lift.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Back squat 4 x 5 at RPE 7. Rest 2-3 min.

blocks.name: Support + muscle
blocks.instruction: Overhead press 3 x 8; lat pulldown or assisted pull-up 4 x 8; split squat 2 x 10 each leg.

blocks.name: Race force
blocks.instruction: Farmers carry 6 x 40 m at L2. Rest 60-90 sec. Finish with 3 x 12 calf raises.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Squat load/RPE, carry load, best and slowest carry split.

sessions.coach_note: Strength work should make race load cheaper, not Tuesday slower.

sessions.title: Controlled 400 m intervals
sessions.purpose: Develop speed reserve and repeatable mechanics above race rhythm.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Run warm-up: 10-12 min easy, drills and 3-4 relaxed strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: BUILD / STANDARD / PERFORMANCE: 6 / 8 / 10 x 400 m at RPE 7.5. Take 75-90 sec easy recovery.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: Stay controlled; this is faster than race pace but never a sprint.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: Use the last two reps to feel 600 m rhythm, not to chase a personal best.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: All 400 m splits, drop-off and final-rep posture.

sessions.coach_note: Stop one rep early if speed is being bought with poor shape.

sessions.title: Aerobic base extension
sessions.purpose: Add durable easy volume without carrying fatigue into Friday.

blocks.name: Main aerobic
blocks.instruction: BUILD / STANDARD / PERFORMANCE: 35 / 45 / 55 min at RPE 4-5.

blocks.name: BUILD option
blocks.instruction: Use 4 min run / 1 min walk. The average effort must remain conversational.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the main prescription. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Durability
blocks.instruction: 4 x 15 sec strides; then 2 rounds of 15 tibialis raises and 30 sec single-leg balance each side.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Duration, distance, HR if available and lower-leg feel.

sessions.coach_note: Correct pace feels almost too easy in the first 15 minutes.

sessions.title: Station muscle circuit
sessions.purpose: Build the muscle behind lunges, pulling, pressing and carries.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Station warm-up. Rehearse every movement with light load before the clock starts.

blocks.name: Format
blocks.instruction: 3-4 quality rounds, not for time: 10 walking lunges each leg, 10 DB bench, 10 rows, 40 m farmers carry. Rest 90 sec.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: Add 4 x 20 m rope pull or heavy backward drag and 5 x 12 legal wall balls.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: Add 4 x 8 alternating DB snatches and 4 x 10 strong Ski pulls.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Loads, reps, legal wall balls and grip quality.

sessions.coach_note: This is hypertrophy and skill. Do not turn it into a metcon.

sessions.title: Aerobic station intervals
sessions.purpose: Learn to move from steady running into controlled station output.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: 10-15 min easy run and machine work, then one light set of the first two stations.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: 5 rounds: 4 min steady run + 2 min work rotating Ski, row, carry, wall balls and sled + 1 min easy transition.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: 5 rounds: 4 min steady run + 2 min work rotating bike, row, DB snatch, lunge and Ski + 1 min easy transition.

blocks.name: Execution
blocks.instruction: RPE 7. Use L2. Finish every 2-min station block with movement still legal.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Run pace, station output, lowest transition control and RPE.

sessions.coach_note: The score is repeatability, not total suffering.

sessions.title: Easy machine + transition skill
sessions.purpose: Add low-impact aerobic work and remove equipment hesitation.

blocks.name: Easy work
blocks.instruction: 20-30 min easy row, bike or SkiErg at RPE 3-4.

blocks.name: Skill
blocks.instruction: Practise footplate, strap, damper and monitor setup; then five calm station exits.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Settings used and one transition cue.

sessions.coach_note: Leave the gym fresher than you entered.

weeks.title: Build repeatability
weeks.checkpoint: Complete the first ordered rehearsal at roughly half volume without turning it into a race.

sessions.title: Deadlift strength + sled pull
sessions.purpose: Raise posterior-chain force and pulling strength while keeping reps fast.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Strength warm-up. Complete 2-4 progressive sets before the first loaded lift.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Deadlift 4 x 4 at RPE 7.5. Rest 2-3 min.

blocks.name: Support + muscle
blocks.instruction: Bench press 4 x 6; rear-foot elevated split squat 3 x 8 each leg; row 3 x 10.

blocks.name: Race force
blocks.instruction: Sled pull 6 x 12.5 m at L2-L3 / RPE 7-8. Then 2 x 15 calf raises.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Deadlift load/RPE, pull load, surface, lane splits and stalls.

sessions.coach_note: Heavy does not mean slow, ugly or maximal.

sessions.title: Threshold blocks
sessions.purpose: Raise the speed that remains controlled for an extended period.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Run warm-up: 10-12 min easy, drills and 3-4 relaxed strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: BUILD / STANDARD / PERFORMANCE: 3 x 6 / 3 x 8 / 3 x 10 min at RPE 7.5-8. Take 3 min easy jog.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: Record each kilometre crossed inside the blocks. Do not surge to hit a round number.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: Record every 600 m crossed inside the blocks. Keep cadence smooth.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Block pace, HR if available, RPE and pace change across blocks.

sessions.coach_note: Threshold is controlled hard. It is not a 5 km race.

sessions.title: Aerobic durability
sessions.purpose: Extend time on feet and protect the ability to recover between hard days.

blocks.name: Main aerobic
blocks.instruction: BUILD / STANDARD / PERFORMANCE: 40 / 50 / 60 min at RPE 4-5.

blocks.name: BUILD option
blocks.instruction: Use 4 min run / 1 min walk or swap the final 10 min to an easy machine.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the main prescription. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Durability
blocks.instruction: 4 relaxed strides only if the legs feel good; 2 x 12 bent-knee and straight-knee calf raises.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Duration, distance and readiness for Friday.

sessions.coach_note: Do not convert recovery capacity into another hard run.

sessions.title: Three-block race AMRAP
sessions.purpose: Build station density while planned rest protects standards.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Station warm-up. Rehearse every movement with light load before the clock starts.

blocks.name: Format
blocks.instruction: 3 x 8-min AMRAP with 3 min easy recovery. Work at RPE 7-7.5 and stop each block before no-reps appear.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: 250 m Ski, 12.5 m sled push, 12.5 m sled pull, 10 wall balls. Use L2-L3.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: 10 cal bike, 10 wall balls, 8 DB snatches, 10 m loaded lunge. Use L2-L3.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Rounds plus reps, block splits, load, no-reps and first limiter.

sessions.coach_note: An AMRAP is paced work, not permission to abandon technique.

sessions.title: Half-volume ordered rehearsal
sessions.purpose: Practise race order, event-distance running and planned restraint.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: 10-15 min easy run and machine work, then one light set of the first two stations.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: 4 x: 1 km run then H1 500 m Ski, H2 25 m push, H3 25 m pull, H4 40 m BBJ. One station per round, L2-L3.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: 5 x: 600 m run then G1 25 cal bike, G2 50 wall balls, G3 500 m row, G4 40 m BBJ, G5 25 snatches solo / 50 doubles shared.

blocks.name: Execution
blocks.instruction: RPE 7.5. Cap run drop-off at 8%. Use planned transitions and full legal ranges.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Every run/station split, transitions, no-reps and first breakdown.

sessions.coach_note: The first ordered rehearsal should create information, not damage.

sessions.title: Downshift + mobility
sessions.purpose: Reduce stiffness after the first high week.

blocks.name: Easy work
blocks.instruction: 20-25 min easy movement at RPE 2-3.

blocks.name: Skill
blocks.instruction: 8-12 min ankles, calves, hips, thoracic rotation and shoulders.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: How recovery changed from start to finish.

sessions.coach_note: Rest completely if easy movement does not improve you.

weeks.title: Absorb and recalibrate
weeks.checkpoint: Drop fatigue, complete one controlled running benchmark and finish the week fresher.

sessions.title: Deload strength + sled skill
sessions.purpose: Retain the important patterns while total loading falls.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Strength warm-up. Complete 2-4 progressive sets before the first loaded lift.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Back squat 3 x 5 at RPE 6. Rest 2 min.

blocks.name: Support + muscle
blocks.instruction: Chest-supported row 3 x 8; DB bench 2 x 8; split squat 2 x 8 each leg.

blocks.name: Race force
blocks.instruction: 4 x 12.5 m push and 4 x 12.5 m pull at L1 / RPE 6.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Loads and how the session changed readiness.

sessions.coach_note: A deload is not the week to sneak in missed work.

sessions.title: Twenty-minute run benchmark
sessions.purpose: Create a simple pace marker without the cost of a maximal 5 km test.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Run warm-up: 10-12 min easy, drills and 3-4 relaxed strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: After the warm-up, cover the greatest repeatable distance in 20 min at RPE 8. Even pacing; no sprint start.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: Record 1 km splits and final distance. Use this result to inform, not dictate, race pace.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: Record every 600 m split and final distance. Note whether cadence survived the final five minutes.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Distance, splits, average pace, RPE and pacing error.

sessions.coach_note: A benchmark is feedback. It is not a verdict.

sessions.title: Easy reset
sessions.purpose: Maintain routine and help fatigue fall.

blocks.name: Main aerobic
blocks.instruction: BUILD / STANDARD / PERFORMANCE: 25 / 35 / 45 min at RPE 3-4.

blocks.name: BUILD option
blocks.instruction: Walk-run is encouraged if the benchmark left any unusual heaviness.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the main prescription. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Durability
blocks.instruction: Easy mobility only. No strides required.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Duration and recovery feel.

sessions.coach_note: No secret threshold work.

sessions.title: Movement-quality EMOM
sessions.purpose: Rehearse legal positions with low station cost.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Station warm-up. Rehearse every movement with light load before the clock starts.

blocks.name: Format
blocks.instruction: 18-min EMOM, 3 rounds of six minutes. Use roughly half the Week 1 reps and L1.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: Ski, push position, rope management, BBJ, wall-ball depth, rest.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: Bike setup, wall-ball depth, row setup, DB snatch lockout, lunge, rest.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: No-rep risks and one technical cue per movement.

sessions.coach_note: A legal slow rep beats a fast penalty.

sessions.title: Short relaxed brick
sessions.purpose: Keep compromised-running rhythm while fatigue continues to fall.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: 10-15 min easy run and machine work, then one light set of the first two stations.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: 3 x 800 m run plus three chosen weakness stations at RV1 and L1-L2.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: 4 x 400 m run plus four chosen weakness stations at RV1 and L1-L2.

blocks.name: Execution
blocks.instruction: RPE 6-6.5. Walk transitions if needed. Finish feeling better than Week 3.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Run splits, movement quality and final readiness.

sessions.coach_note: Stop while you still want another round.

sessions.title: Walk + plan update
sessions.purpose: Convert the first block into better decisions.

blocks.name: Easy work
blocks.instruction: 20-30 min easy walk.

blocks.name: Skill
blocks.instruction: Update race pace, weak stations, equipment needs and one recovery habit.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Three decisions for Weeks 5-8.

sessions.coach_note: Data without a decision is trivia.

weeks.title: Own race distance
weeks.checkpoint: Introduce target event-distance pace and a controlled 55-60% ordered rehearsal.

sessions.title: Squat strength + sled push
sessions.purpose: Raise force reserve and touch heavier race-specific pushing.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Strength warm-up. Complete 2-4 progressive sets before the first loaded lift.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Back squat 5 x 3 at RPE 8. Rest 2-3 min.

blocks.name: Support + muscle
blocks.instruction: Lat pulldown or pull-up 4 x 6; overhead press 3 x 6; reverse lunge 2 x 8 each leg.

blocks.name: Race force
blocks.instruction: Sled push 6 x 12.5 m at L3-L4 / RPE 8. Finish with 3 x 12 calf raises and 2 x 30 sec suitcase hold.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Squat load/RPE, sled load, turf, lane splits and foot stops.

sessions.coach_note: Race load is earned by clean movement, not demanded by the calendar.

sessions.title: Race-distance intervals
sessions.purpose: Build repeatable target rhythm at the exact event run distance.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Run warm-up: 10-12 min easy, drills and 3-4 relaxed strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: Run at target race effort, not fresh 5 km pace. Keep fastest-to-slowest drop-off within 5%.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: BUILD / STANDARD / PERFORMANCE: 4 / 5 / 6 x 1 km with 90 sec easy recovery.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: BUILD / STANDARD / PERFORMANCE: 6 / 8 / 10 x 600 m with 75-90 sec easy recovery.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Every split, drop-off, RPE and whether posture was restored before the next rep.

sessions.coach_note: The best race pace is the pace that survives the stations.

sessions.title: Aerobic durability
sessions.purpose: Extend easy running tolerance as race-specific work rises.

blocks.name: Main aerobic
blocks.instruction: BUILD / STANDARD / PERFORMANCE: 45 / 55 / 65 min at RPE 4-5.

blocks.name: BUILD option
blocks.instruction: Use 5 min run / 1 min walk or replace the final 15 min with an easy machine.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the main prescription. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Durability
blocks.instruction: 4 x 15 sec strides; then 2 x 15 tibialis raises and 2 x 12 calf raises.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Duration, distance, HR if available and lower-leg feel.

sessions.coach_note: Durability comes from repeatable easy work.

sessions.title: Station force clusters
sessions.purpose: Practise powerful chunks with full rest before Saturday.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Station warm-up. Rehearse every movement with light load before the clock starts.

blocks.name: Format
blocks.instruction: 4 quality rounds with 2 min rest. Use L3. Each round should stay within 8% of the first.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: 250 m Ski, 12.5 m push, 12.5 m pull, 25 m farmers carry, 12 wall balls.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: 10 cal bike, 10 DB snatches, 20 m farmers carry, 10 m lunge, 12 wall balls.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Round splits, loads, no-reps and lowest-quality movement.

sessions.coach_note: This is force and skill, not Friday-night destruction.

sessions.title: Fifty-five percent race build
sessions.purpose: Extend compromised running with more event order and realistic loading.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: 10-15 min easy run and machine work, then one light set of the first two stations.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: 5 x 1 km, each followed by H1, H2, H3, H6 and H8 at RV2. Use L3; one station per round.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: 6 x 600 m, each followed by G1-G6 at RV2. Use L3; one station per round.

blocks.name: Execution
blocks.instruction: RPE 7.5-8. Planned breaks only. Reduce station volume if running loses more than 8%.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Every split, transitions, break plan accuracy, no-reps and first limiter.

sessions.coach_note: Do not win the opening kilometres and lose the session.

sessions.title: Recovery + standards
sessions.purpose: Restore while reinforcing the standards most likely to create penalties.

blocks.name: Easy work
blocks.instruction: 20-30 min easy movement at RPE 2-3.

blocks.name: Skill
blocks.instruction: Practise five perfect reps of two weak movements; stop before fatigue.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Movement cues and recovery feel.

sessions.coach_note: No sweating for a score.

weeks.title: Hold output
weeks.checkpoint: Make Friday the density day and Saturday the lower-cost aerobic hybrid day.

sessions.title: Deadlift strength + pull capacity
sessions.purpose: Build posterior-chain and upper-back strength for pulls, carries and machines.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Strength warm-up. Complete 2-4 progressive sets before the first loaded lift.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Deadlift 4 x 3 at RPE 8. Rest 2-3 min.

blocks.name: Support + muscle
blocks.instruction: Bench press 4 x 6; chest-supported row 4 x 8; reverse lunge 3 x 8 each leg.

blocks.name: Race force
blocks.instruction: Sled pull 4 x 25 m at L3 / RPE 8. Rest until lane speed is repeatable.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Deadlift load/RPE, sled splits, rope errors and grip quality.

sessions.coach_note: No grind reps that compromise the next 48 hours.

sessions.title: Extended threshold
sessions.purpose: Increase controlled-hard running time without chasing maximal pace.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Run warm-up: 10-12 min easy, drills and 3-4 relaxed strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: BUILD 2 x 10 min; STANDARD 2 x 12 min; PERFORMANCE 3 x 10 min at RPE 7.5-8. Take 4 min easy jog.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: Track 1 km splits inside the blocks and avoid any finish-line sprint.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: Track 600 m splits inside the blocks and keep cadence controlled.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Block pace, RPE, HR if available and pace drift.

sessions.coach_note: Threshold work should finish hard and organised, not flooded.

sessions.title: Long easy aerobic
sessions.purpose: Build the aerobic base that restores pace after each station.

blocks.name: Main aerobic
blocks.instruction: BUILD / STANDARD / PERFORMANCE: 50 / 60 / 70 min at RPE 4-5.

blocks.name: BUILD option
blocks.instruction: Use 5 min run / 1 min walk. Preserve the full duration before chasing continuous running.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the main prescription. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Durability
blocks.instruction: No strides required. Complete 2 rounds of calf and tibialis work.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Duration, distance, HR and morning readiness.

sessions.coach_note: Most of the programme should not feel like a race.

sessions.title: Thirty-minute station density
sessions.purpose: Improve local muscular endurance with planned resets between blocks.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Station warm-up. Rehearse every movement with light load before the clock starts.

blocks.name: Format
blocks.instruction: 3 x 8-min AMRAP with 3 min easy recovery. Use L3 and RPE 7.5.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: Alternate blocks: 300 m Ski/row, 20 wall balls, 40 m farmers, 20 m lunge.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: Alternate blocks: 12 cal bike, 250 m row/Ski, 10 DB snatches, 20 m farmers.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Rounds, reps, block drop-off, no-reps and first limiter.

sessions.coach_note: If standards fail, the score stops being useful.

sessions.title: Aerobic compromised transitions
sessions.purpose: Practise returning to running without adding another maximal session.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: 10-15 min easy run and machine work, then one light set of the first two stations.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: 50 min total at RPE 6-7. Every 10 min: 60-90 sec on H1, H4, H6, H8, then return to easy running.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: 50 min total at RPE 6-7. Every 10 min: 60-90 sec on G1, G4, G5, G9, then return to easy running.

blocks.name: Execution
blocks.instruction: Stations use L2-L3. The four minutes after each station must settle back to conversational control.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Pace before/after stations, time to settle and any movement issue.

sessions.coach_note: Today teaches recovery between efforts, not survival.

sessions.title: Easy mobility reset
sessions.purpose: Down-regulate after the density week.

blocks.name: Easy work
blocks.instruction: 15-25 min walk or easy spin at RPE 2-3.

blocks.name: Skill
blocks.instruction: 10 min calves, hips, thoracic rotation and shoulders.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Readiness after the session.

sessions.coach_note: Rest is a valid choice.

weeks.title: Peak broad workload
weeks.checkpoint: Complete the largest broad week with full-load confidence and one 65-70% ordered rehearsal.

sessions.title: Peak strength + full-load carry
sessions.purpose: Peak the broad force block before race specificity takes over.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Strength warm-up. Complete 2-4 progressive sets before the first loaded lift.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Back squat 1 x 3 at RPE 8, then 3 x 3 at about 90% of that set.

blocks.name: Support + muscle
blocks.instruction: Overhead press 3 x 5; pull-up or pulldown 4 x 6; split squat 2 x 8 each leg.

blocks.name: Race force
blocks.instruction: Farmers carry 4 x 60 m at L4; sled push 4 x 12.5 m at L4 / RPE 8. Full rest.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Strength loads, carry/sled splits, grip and any stalls.

sessions.coach_note: Full load only counts when it is legal and repeatable.

sessions.title: Race-distance volume
sessions.purpose: Build confidence repeating target rhythm with shorter recoveries.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Run warm-up: 10-12 min easy, drills and 3-4 relaxed strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: Hold target race pace. BUILD uses lower rep count, not a faster pace.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: BUILD / STANDARD / PERFORMANCE: 5 / 6 / 7 x 1 km with 60-75 sec easy recovery.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: BUILD / STANDARD / PERFORMANCE: 7 / 9 / 10 x 600 m with 60 sec easy recovery.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Every split, drop-off, RPE and last-rep movement quality.

sessions.coach_note: The target is repeatable pace, not ego pace.

sessions.title: Peak easy duration
sessions.purpose: Complete the longest low-intensity run before volume starts to fall.

blocks.name: Main aerobic
blocks.instruction: BUILD / STANDARD / PERFORMANCE: 50 / 60 / 70 min at RPE 4-5.

blocks.name: BUILD option
blocks.instruction: Use 5 min run / 1 min walk or finish 15 min on an easy machine.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the main prescription. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Durability
blocks.instruction: 4 relaxed strides only if the legs feel fresh; complete lower-leg durability.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Duration, distance and readiness for the final two sessions.

sessions.coach_note: Long and easy is enough.

sessions.title: Full-load station confidence
sessions.purpose: Touch race load in short chunks with enough rest to protect quality.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Station warm-up. Rehearse every movement with light load before the clock starts.

blocks.name: Format
blocks.instruction: 2 quality sets. Rest 2 min between movements and 3 min between sets. Stop well before fatigue.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: 250 m Ski or row, 12.5 m push or pull, 25 m carry or lunge, 10 wall balls. Alternate choices on set 2; use L4 where safe.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: 10 cal bike or 200 m machine, 8 snatches, 20 m lunge or carry, 10 m push or pull, 10 wall balls. Use L4 where safe.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Loads, each split, no-reps, grip and sled movement.

sessions.coach_note: Confidence comes from clean exposure, not a failed rep.

sessions.title: Sixty-five percent ordered rehearsal
sessions.purpose: Blend event-distance running, race load and event order at controlled cost.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: 10-15 min easy run and machine work, then one light set of the first two stations.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: 6 x 1 km, each followed by H1-H6 at RV3. Use L4 on sled/carry only when movement is clean.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: 7 x 600 m, each followed by G1-G7 at RV3. Use L4 where safe.

blocks.name: Execution
blocks.instruction: RPE 8 maximum. Cap run drop-off at 8%; end the session if pain changes movement.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Run/station splits, transitions, break plan, no-reps and first limiter.

sessions.coach_note: The hard week is successful only if standards survive.

sessions.title: Recovery walk
sessions.purpose: Unload after the largest broad workload.

blocks.name: Easy work
blocks.instruction: 20-30 min easy walk.

blocks.name: Skill
blocks.instruction: Optional 5-8 min gentle mobility only.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Morning readiness and leg heaviness.

sessions.coach_note: Do less rather than more.

weeks.title: Drop fatigue, keep rhythm
weeks.checkpoint: Reconfirm target pace and movement quality before the most specific block.

sessions.title: Strength reset + sled speed
sessions.purpose: Retain force while reducing total lifting and station volume.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Strength warm-up. Complete 2-4 progressive sets before the first loaded lift.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Deadlift 3 x 4 at RPE 6.5-7. Rest 2 min.

blocks.name: Support + muscle
blocks.instruction: Bench press 3 x 6; row 3 x 8; split squat 2 x 8 each leg.

blocks.name: Race force
blocks.instruction: 4 x 12.5 m push and 4 x 12.5 m pull at L2 / RPE 6-7.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Loads, sled speed and recovery feel.

sessions.coach_note: The best deload result is renewed appetite for work.

sessions.title: Race-pace recalibration
sessions.purpose: Check target pace with generous recovery and no test-day pressure.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Run warm-up: 10-12 min easy, drills and 3-4 relaxed strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: All reps at current target pace. Take 2 min easy recovery.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: 4 x 1 km. Update target only if all four reps are within 5% and controlled.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: 6 x 600 m. Update target only if all six reps are within 5% and controlled.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Splits, drop-off, RPE and any target-pace change.

sessions.coach_note: One fast rep is not evidence for a faster race plan.

sessions.title: Easy aerobic reset
sessions.purpose: Maintain aerobic volume while fatigue falls.

blocks.name: Main aerobic
blocks.instruction: BUILD / STANDARD / PERFORMANCE: 35 / 45 / 55 min at RPE 3-4.

blocks.name: BUILD option
blocks.instruction: Run-walk or easy machine work is acceptable for the full session.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the main prescription. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Durability
blocks.instruction: Mobility only. No speed required.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Duration and readiness change.

sessions.coach_note: Keep it simple.

sessions.title: Low-cost station EMOM
sessions.purpose: Retain race rhythm with a clear rep cap.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Station warm-up. Rehearse every movement with light load before the clock starts.

blocks.name: Format
blocks.instruction: 20-min EMOM: five working minutes for four rounds. Leave at least 20 sec every minute. Use L2.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: Ski/row, wall balls, carry, lunge, BBJ. Use 40-50% of Week 7 per-minute output.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: Bike/row, wall balls, DB snatch, lunge, BBJ. Use 40-50% of Week 7 per-minute output.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Completed minutes, lowest rest and movement notes.

sessions.coach_note: Stop before fatigue changes the skill.

sessions.title: Controlled weakness brick
sessions.purpose: Touch weak stations without paying another rehearsal cost.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: 10-15 min easy run and machine work, then one light set of the first two stations.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: 4 x 800 m plus H4, H6, H7 and H8 at RV2. One station per round, L2.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: 5 x 400 m plus G2, G4, G6, G8 and G10 at RV2. One station per round, L2.

blocks.name: Execution
blocks.instruction: RPE 6.5-7. Finish with the same posture and transition control used at the start.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Splits, no-rep risk and one Week 9 decision.

sessions.coach_note: Finish ready for the specific block.

sessions.title: Recovery + race-plan update
sessions.purpose: Turn better data into a sharper race plan.

blocks.name: Easy work
blocks.instruction: 20-30 min easy walk, bike or row.

blocks.name: Skill
blocks.instruction: Set target opening pace, three station break plans and one equipment decision.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Updated race-plan fields.

sessions.coach_note: Make decisions now, not under adrenaline.

weeks.title: Dress rehearsal
weeks.checkpoint: Complete the only full-order major rehearsal, then recover rather than chasing another one.

sessions.title: Strength maintenance + race-load sled
sessions.purpose: Maintain force and confidence while total gym volume falls.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Strength warm-up. Complete 2-4 progressive sets before the first loaded lift.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Back squat 3 x 3 at RPE 7.5. Rest 2-3 min.

blocks.name: Support + muscle
blocks.instruction: Overhead press 3 x 5; pulldown or pull-up 3 x 6; reverse lunge 2 x 6 each leg.

blocks.name: Race force
blocks.instruction: 4 x 12.5 m push and pull at L4 / RPE 8; 2 x 100 m farmers at race load with full rest.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Loads, splits, turf and readiness 24 hours later.

sessions.coach_note: Maintenance should leave the legs useful.

sessions.title: Race-pace repeatability
sessions.purpose: Lock target rhythm with shorter recovery before the dress rehearsal.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Run warm-up: 10-12 min easy, drills and 3-4 relaxed strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: All reps at target race pace. Do not make the final rep faster.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: BUILD / STANDARD / PERFORMANCE: 5 / 6 / 7 x 1 km with 60 sec easy recovery.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: BUILD / STANDARD / PERFORMANCE: 7 / 8 / 10 x 600 m with 45-60 sec easy recovery.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Splits, drop-off, RPE and breathing control before each start.

sessions.coach_note: Target pace should now feel boring and repeatable.

sessions.title: Easy support run
sessions.purpose: Support the key week without adding another hard stimulus.

blocks.name: Main aerobic
blocks.instruction: BUILD / STANDARD / PERFORMANCE: 40 / 50 / 60 min at RPE 4.

blocks.name: BUILD option
blocks.instruction: Use run-walk freely. Reduce by 10 min if Monday or Tuesday created unusual heaviness.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the main prescription. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Durability
blocks.instruction: 3 relaxed strides only when legs feel normal; brief calf work.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Duration, distance and readiness for the dress rehearsal.

sessions.coach_note: Protect Saturday.

sessions.title: Dress-rehearsal primer
sessions.purpose: Prime equipment and planned breaks without pre-fatiguing Saturday.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Station warm-up. Rehearse every movement with light load before the clock starts.

blocks.name: Format
blocks.instruction: 2 easy quality rounds with 90 sec between movements. Use L3-L4 and low volume.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: 250 m Ski/row, 12.5 m sled, 20 m carry/lunge, 12 wall balls. Rehearse exact settings and break cues.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: 8 cal bike, 200 m row/Ski, 8 snatches, 10 m sled, 12 wall balls. Rehearse exact settings and break cues.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Settings, cues, no-reps and confidence.

sessions.coach_note: This is a primer, not a fitness test.

sessions.title: Major full-order dress rehearsal
sessions.purpose: Rehearse the entire order at about 70-75% total race cost.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: 10-15 min easy run and machine work, then one light set of the first two stations.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: 8 x 1 km in full order with H1-H8 at 50% station volume. Use L4 on race-loaded stations where safe.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: 10 x 600 m in full order with G1-G10 at 50% station volume, then 100 m controlled fast. DB snatch: 25 solo / 50 doubles shared.

blocks.name: Execution
blocks.instruction: Use race kit, settings, planned breaks and transitions. RPE 8 cap. Take the next 48 hours easy.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Every split, transition, no-rep, fuel test, kit issue and three final decisions.

sessions.coach_note: Race the plan, not the room.

sessions.title: Recovery + rehearsal review
sessions.purpose: Recover and turn the major rehearsal into fixed decisions.

blocks.name: Easy work
blocks.instruction: 20-30 min easy walk or spin at RPE 2-3.

blocks.name: Skill
blocks.instruction: Write three decisions: opening pace, station break plan and transition cue.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Recovery feel and final plan changes.

sessions.coach_note: The rehearsal is wasted if nothing is learned.

weeks.title: Consolidate, do not repeat the race
weeks.checkpoint: Keep intensity and event rhythm while total race volume drops after the dress rehearsal.

sessions.title: Low-volume strength + sled touch
sessions.purpose: Retain force without creating soreness.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Strength warm-up. Complete 2-4 progressive sets before the first loaded lift.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Deadlift 3 x 3 at RPE 7. Rest 2-3 min.

blocks.name: Support + muscle
blocks.instruction: Bench press 3 x 5; row 3 x 6; split squat 2 x 6 each leg.

blocks.name: Race force
blocks.instruction: 3 x 12.5 m push and 3 x 12.5 m pull at L3 / RPE 7.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Loads, sled splits and next-day feel.

sessions.coach_note: No accessory soreness is useful now.

sessions.title: Pace lock
sessions.purpose: Rehearse race rhythm with enough recovery to feel sharp.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Run warm-up: 10-12 min easy, drills and 3-4 relaxed strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: Target pace only. Take 2 min easy recovery.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: BUILD / STANDARD / PERFORMANCE: 4 / 5 / 5 x 1 km.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: BUILD / STANDARD / PERFORMANCE: 6 / 7 / 8 x 600 m.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Splits, RPE and whether target pace felt under control.

sessions.coach_note: This should build belief, not fatigue.

sessions.title: Easy aerobic support
sessions.purpose: Maintain the engine while dress-rehearsal fatigue clears.

blocks.name: Main aerobic
blocks.instruction: BUILD / STANDARD / PERFORMANCE: 40 / 50 / 60 min at RPE 3-4.

blocks.name: BUILD option
blocks.instruction: Run-walk or machine substitution is acceptable.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the main prescription. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Durability
blocks.instruction: No strides if any residual heaviness remains.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Duration and readiness trend.

sessions.coach_note: Leave fuel in the tank.

sessions.title: Race-rhythm EMOM
sessions.purpose: Retain crisp station rhythm with a clear time cap.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Station warm-up. Rehearse every movement with light load before the clock starts.

blocks.name: Format
blocks.instruction: 24-min EMOM, four rounds of six minutes. Leave 12-20 sec every minute; use L3.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: 12 cal Ski, 12.5 m push, 12.5 m pull, 10 m BBJ, 12 cal row, rest.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: 10 cal bike, 12 wall balls, 200 m row, 8 m BBJ, 8 DB snatches, rest.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Completed minutes, lowest rest, no-reps and confidence.

sessions.coach_note: If output slows badly, stop. The session has done its job.

sessions.title: Weakness-specific brick
sessions.purpose: Rehearse the stations most likely to damage the next run.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: 10-15 min easy run and machine work, then one light set of the first two stations.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: 4 x 1 km, each followed by one of H2, H3, H7 and H8 at RV2. Use L3-L4.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: 5 x 600 m, each followed by one of G2, G5, G6, G8 and G10 at RV2. Use L3-L4.

blocks.name: Execution
blocks.instruction: RPE 7.5. Use final race break plans and stop while control is high.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Run/station splits, break-plan accuracy and final no-rep risks.

sessions.coach_note: Specific does not mean maximal.

sessions.title: Easy recovery
sessions.purpose: Reduce tension after the final moderate-high week.

blocks.name: Easy work
blocks.instruction: 20-30 min easy walk, bike or row at RPE 2-3.

blocks.name: Skill
blocks.instruction: Five minutes of comfortable mobility.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Recovery feel.

sessions.coach_note: Do less.

weeks.title: Keep speed, lose fatigue
weeks.checkpoint: Reduce total work, retain small doses of race pace and lock the race plan.

sessions.title: Strength maintenance primer
sessions.purpose: Keep strength switched on with minimal fatigue.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Strength warm-up. Complete 2-4 progressive sets before the first loaded lift.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Back squat 2 x 3 at RPE 7. Rest 2-3 min.

blocks.name: Support + muscle
blocks.instruction: DB bench 2 x 5; row 2 x 6; reverse lunge 2 x 5 each leg.

blocks.name: Race force
blocks.instruction: 2 x 12.5 m push and pull at L4; 2 x 50 m carry at race load. Full rest.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Loads, speed and confidence.

sessions.coach_note: Sharp, clean and finished early.

sessions.title: Race-pace sharpening
sessions.purpose: Feel target pace with generous recovery and a small speed touch.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Run warm-up: 10-12 min easy, drills and 3-4 relaxed strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: Complete target-pace reps, then 2 x 200 m fast but relaxed with full walk recovery.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: BUILD / STANDARD / PERFORMANCE: 3 / 4 / 4 x 1 km with 2.5 min easy recovery.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: BUILD / STANDARD / PERFORMANCE: 4 / 5 / 5 x 600 m with 2 min easy recovery.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Splits, feel and whether the final rep stayed relaxed.

sessions.coach_note: Pace should feel sharper because recovery is generous.

sessions.title: Easy taper run
sessions.purpose: Maintain routine while fatigue falls.

blocks.name: Main aerobic
blocks.instruction: BUILD / STANDARD / PERFORMANCE: 30 / 40 / 50 min at RPE 3-4.

blocks.name: BUILD option
blocks.instruction: Use run-walk or reduce by 10 min if readiness is heavy.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the main prescription. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Durability
blocks.instruction: Optional 3 x 15 sec strides only when legs feel good.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Duration and taper feel.

sessions.coach_note: Do not add work because you feel good.

sessions.title: Full-load confidence primer
sessions.purpose: Touch race loads at low volume and zero failure risk.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Station warm-up. Rehearse every movement with light load before the clock starts.

blocks.name: Format
blocks.instruction: 18-min EMOM: six minutes for three rounds. Use roughly 50% of Week 10 reps.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: Ski/row, sled push, sled pull, carry, wall balls, rest. Race load only where clean.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: Bike, wall balls, DB snatch, carry/lunge, sled, rest. Race load only where clean.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Completed minutes, settings, no-reps and confidence.

sessions.coach_note: A primer is a workout you do not need to recover from.

sessions.title: Short race-rhythm brick
sessions.purpose: Keep the feel of running into stations while taper volume falls.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: 10-15 min easy run and machine work, then one light set of the first two stations.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: 3 x 800 m plus three stations at RV1. Use planned transitions and L2-L3.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: 4 x 400 m plus four stations at RV1. Use planned transitions and L2-L3.

blocks.name: Execution
blocks.instruction: RPE 7. Finish confident. Confirm race-day checklist after cooling down.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Run splits, feel and checklist status.

sessions.coach_note: Stop while you want more.

sessions.title: Walk + final plan
sessions.purpose: Keep moving and remove race-day uncertainty.

blocks.name: Easy work
blocks.instruction: 20-30 min easy walk.

blocks.name: Skill
blocks.instruction: Confirm travel, check-in, kit, nutrition, warm-up, settings and break plans.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Race plan complete: yes/no.

sessions.coach_note: Calm is performance.

weeks.title: Race ready
weeks.checkpoint: Fitness is built. Shift the primers around the actual race day and arrive hungry to perform.

sessions.title: Strength primer
sessions.purpose: Touch strength and race implements 5-7 days before racing.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Strength warm-up. Complete 2-4 progressive sets before the first loaded lift.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Trap-bar deadlift or back squat 2 x 2 at RPE 6.5-7. Stop if bar speed is not sharp.

blocks.name: Support + muscle
blocks.instruction: DB bench 2 x 5; row 2 x 5. No hypertrophy finishers.

blocks.name: Race force
blocks.instruction: 2 easy sled lanes and 2 x 30 m carry at L2-L3.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Readiness and confidence only.

sessions.coach_note: Leave hungry.

sessions.title: Final race-pace touch
sessions.purpose: Feel target pace one final time 3-5 days before racing.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Run warm-up: 10-12 min easy, drills and 3-4 relaxed strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: Full easy recovery and no faster finish. Add 2 relaxed strides only if useful.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: 2 x 1 km at target pace with 3 min easy recovery.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: 3 x 600 m at target pace with 2.5 min easy recovery.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Splits and confidence.

sessions.coach_note: Sharp, not strained.

sessions.title: Easy movement + mobility
sessions.purpose: Reduce stiffness and maintain routine.

blocks.name: Main aerobic
blocks.instruction: BUILD / STANDARD / PERFORMANCE: 20 / 25 / 30 min at RPE 2-3.

blocks.name: BUILD option
blocks.instruction: Walk or machine work is fully acceptable.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the main prescription. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Durability
blocks.instruction: Five minutes of comfortable mobility. No loaded durability work.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Feel before and after.

sessions.coach_note: No extra work.

sessions.title: Twelve-minute station touch
sessions.purpose: Rehearse settings and movement rhythm 2-3 days before racing.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: Use the Station warm-up. Rehearse every movement with light load before the clock starts.

blocks.name: Format
blocks.instruction: 12-min EMOM, three rounds of four minutes. Use RV1 and L1-L2.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: 8 cal Ski/row, 8 wall balls, 10 m sled or 20 m carry, rest.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: 8 cal bike/row, 6 DB snatches, 8 wall balls or 10 m sled, rest.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Settings, kit check and confidence.

sessions.coach_note: This is reassurance, not training.

sessions.title: RACE DAY
sessions.purpose: Execute the event, movement standards and decisions rehearsed for twelve weeks.

blocks.name: Prep
blocks.instruction: 10-15 min easy run and machine work, then one light set of the first two stations.

blocks.name: TRACK H
blocks.instruction: 8 x 1 km with H1-H8 at full official volume and your registered division load.

blocks.name: TRACK G
blocks.instruction: 10 x 600 m with G1-G10 at full official volume, then the 200 m finish. Use your registered category rules.

blocks.name: Execution
blocks.instruction: Open below emotional pace. Use planned breaks. Judge every station by the quality of the run that follows.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Official time, every split, penalties, plan changes and one thing done well.

sessions.coach_note: The fitness is built. Race day is decision-making under pressure.

sessions.title: Post-race review
sessions.purpose: Turn the result into the next intelligent training block.

blocks.name: Easy work
blocks.instruction: Within 24-48 hours, use easy walking only as desired. No forced recovery workout.

blocks.name: Skill
blocks.instruction: Review pace loss, station limiter, penalties, fuel, kit and taper response.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: What worked, what failed and the next priority.

sessions.coach_note: The next programme starts with an honest review.
